findings.text: Side effect of B-MG-38 (cursor only from SSE): until the first SSE event arrives, sseCursor is 0 and connectSSE() reconnects with no ?after, which the server reads as 'future only'. A drop before the first event loses messages posted in the gap for loaded conversations; onopen refreshes only the list and unread counts. Not reproduced live. Consider a reload of the active conversation on resume.

Live: after saving an inline edit with Enter, focus is not returned to the composer. An immediate ArrowUp did nothing (editors=0), and I had to click the composer first. Escape and save both closed the editor correctly. Cosmetic.
